technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage official externalized Fabric Go modules (such as fabric-protos-go, fabric-config, and related reusable common libraries) to replace internal and third_party vendored code copies.
Refactor internal call sites within fabric-sdk-go to import external packages directly without breaking public SDK API contracts where applicable.
Implement temporary go.mod parsing/inclusion logic within the chaincode packaging module to detect and honor go.mod during chaincode deployment.
assumptions: External Go modules containing the required protoext, cauthdsl, ccprovider, ledger, configtxgen, and configtxlator structures are publicly available or accessible in target versions.
The Go SDK test suite and integration test environment (dockerized Fabric network) are fully operational and available for local developer testing.
Existing public APIs of the SDK will remain backward compatible, requiring internal re-mapping where necessary.

activities.activity_description: Analyze existing vendor/internal code copies across internal/ and third_party/ against available external Fabric Go modules to establish mapping and update plan.
Remove internal modified copy of gossip/protoext and discovery client under internal/github.com/hyperledger/fabric/gossip and refactor imports to externalized modules.

activities.activity_name: Externalize cauthdsl, ccprovider, and Ledger Utilities (U2, U3, U4)
activities.activity_description: Remove third_party copies of cauthdsl, ccprovider, and core/ledger utilities, replacing them with imports from common external packages.

activities.activity_name: Externalize Internal Common and Core Utilities (U5)
activities.activity_description: Refactor internal copies under internal/github.com/hyperledger/fabric/common and core to use common external modules.
Implement a temporary workaround in the chaincode packager to parse and honor go.mod files included within chaincode packages.

activities.activity_name: Externalize Configtxgen and Configtxlator Functions (U7, U8)
activities.activity_description: Replace internal copies of configtxgen and configtxlator functions in pkg/fab/resource/configtx.go and sdkinternal with external library calls.
Run unit, integration, and E2E SDK test suites against a test Fabric network to ensure no regressions were introduced by dependency changes.

activities.activity_name: Code Cleanup and Module Dependency Finalization
activities.activity_description: Purge unused internal/third_party directories, run go mod tidy, and update documentation and dependency manifests.
